parameters.name: Affinity
parameters.description: The affinity level of the deployment set. Instances in the deployment set are distributed based on this affinity level. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: DeploymentSetName
parameters.description: The name of the deployment set. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the deployment set. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: GroupCount
parameters.description:
The number of groups for the high availability group strategy. Valid values: 1 to 7.

Default value: 3.

> This parameter takes effect only when `Strategy=AvailabilityGroup`.

parameters.name: OnUnableToRedeployFailedInstance
parameters.description:
The emergency solution to use when an instance in the deployment set cannot be evenly distributed to available inventory after a failover. Valid values: 
         
- CancelMembershipAndStart: Removes the instance from the deployment set and starts the instance immediately after the failover.
- KeepStopped: Keeps the deployment set attributes of the instance and leaves the instance in the Stopped state.

Default value: CancelMembershipAndStart.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Strategy
parameters.description:
The deployment strategy. Valid values:
- Availability: High availability strategy.
- AvailabilityGroup: High availability group strategy.
- LowLatency: Low network latency strategy.

Default value: Availability.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The deployment type. Valid values:
- host: physical server
- sw: vSwitch
- rack: rack

Default value: host.
